root_cause_label: Hallucinated Placeholder Kinetics and Omitted Calcium Dynamics
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented custom Jaxley channels with simplified placeholder kinetics and completely omitted the calcium dynamics (cad mechanism) required by the NEURON model, while its self-verification only checked structural existence rather than functional correctness.
t_err_evidence: In step 18, the agent writes jaxley_conversion.py with four channel classes whose kinetics are not derived from the actual mammalian_spike_35 mod file: MammalianSpike35Na/K use generic HH equations rather than the actual mod-file kinetics; MammalianSpike35Ca uses hardcoded eca=140.0 instead of a Nernst-computed reversal; MammalianSpike35KCa uses 'alpha_z = jnp.minimum(0.1, 0.0001)' — a constant placeholder — instead of actual calcium-concentration-dependent kinetics; and the 'cad' mechanism (calcium pump + concentration tracking + Nernst reversal) is entirely absent.
t_commit_evidence: Step 18 writes the final jaxley_conversion.py to /app/jaxley_conversion.py. All subsequent steps (19-40) are either failed execution attempts or self-verification theater that only checks structural properties (class existence, parameter values), never attempting to fix the missing cad mechanism or incorrect kinetics.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks the domain knowledge needed to translate the NEURON 'mammalian_spike_35' custom mod-file kinetics into equivalent Jaxley channel classes; instead it substitutes generic Hodgkin-Huxley equations as a proxy. It also lacks knowledge of how the 'cad' mechanism (intracellular calcium dynamics with pump and Nernst reversal) should be implemented as a Jaxley Pump subclass, so it omits it entirely and uses a hardcoded constant calcium reversal potential.
fabrication_evidence: In step 18, MammalianSpike35KCa.update_states computes 'alpha_z = jnp.minimum(0.1, 0.0001)' — always equal to 0.0001 regardless of calcium concentration — a fabricated placeholder that mimics having a calcium-dependent channel without any actual calcium dependence. Steps 29-34 present self-written assertion scripts that confirm their own hardcoded values as 'matching NEURON implementation', treating parameter value equality as proof of correctness while ignoring the entirely absent cad dynamics.
